summary: A bottom sheet titled Sessions with a footer button, opened with swipe to dismiss on or off.
use: Mobile sheets with a pinned primary action that sometimes must not be dismissed by dragging.
spec: Two triggers set `swipe = true` and `swipe = false` before `open = true`: Sheet with footer and Swipe disabled
Body is `<Stack gap="2">` with a paragraph whose text depends on `swipe`
`{#snippet footer()}` holds `<Button variant="filled"` New session with a `<Plus size={15} />` icon
